jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
At LHH we are looking for a DevOps Engineer for an important inernational company.

Job overview

Your role will be to build an optimized, secure and performing environment for their services and also to support development needs.

You will integrate a dynamic team and help them achieve the next steps in technical evolutions. You have DevOps skills to deploy Infra as Code in Cloud environments and a solid Linux background

Main tasks & responsibilities

As infrastructure engineer, you will parBcipate in these missions:

Ensure the stability and the performance of the production environment

Maintain the current infrastructure (Linux / Windows)

Keep track of potential security issues and fix them

Support the development teams so that they can deploy the code in a proper environment

Maintain an automated environment and improve automation across all infrastructure components (IaC)

Improve the quality of the environments for services and users

Requirements

Mid/Senior... profile

Administration of Linux servers (Ubuntu)

Devops skills (GitLab, ansible, terraform)

Knowledge of AWS cloud administration

Experience working with open-source website environments

Fluent in English and able to work in an international context

Familiar with agile development methods (Kanban, Scrum)

Passionate about sysadmin/devops stuff

Problem solver, able to fix issues in critical moments

Nice to have

Administration of Windows Servers

Directories (AD/LDAP) knowledge

VPN services experience

MySQL Database tuning experience

Good communication skills to exchange within the team and with other teams

jobs_results.title: DevOps H/M
jobs_results.description:
We're looking for an assistant DevOps Engineer to join our Technology Exploration Unit team in Granada, Spain.

Our Technology:

We are the world leader in Resilient Positioning, Navigation and Timing (R-PNT) solutions that improve the reliability, performance, and safety of critical applications, and high-risk operations, even in GPS/GNSS-denied environments. We provide virtually fail-safe GNSS and PNT solutions for military and commercial applications worldwide, and ultra-precise synchronization (sub-ns) and frequency distribution for applications requiring a high degree of reliability and precision through White Rabbit PTP.

In addition, Safran has great expertise in Time Sensitive Networking (TSN) through several projects in the framework of aerospace with ESA to provide deterministic communications with zero-packet loss. Overall, we deliver highly dependable solutions that always have high accuracy and robust timing at their core.

The Position:
The DevOps Engineer plays a... crucial role in bridging the gap between development and quality assurance. They are responsible for streamlining the software delivery process, ensuring the efficiency, reliability, and scalability of systems while fostering a culture of collaboration between different teams.

What you'll be doing:
· Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD): Implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines to automate the build, test, and deployment processes.

· Monitoring and Logging: Setting up monitoring tools and establishing logging practices to ensure system stability, performance optimization, and proactive issue identification.

· Collaboration and Communication: Facilitating communication between development, operations, and other teams, promoting a collaborative DevOps culture.

· Scripting and Tool Development: Writing scripts and developing tools to automate manual processes and improve system efficiency.

What you Bring to Safran:
· 2+ years of experience in DevOps or similar roles.
· Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
· Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, Bash, etc.) and automation tools.
· Experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or CircleCI.
· Containers (Dockers) and containers orchestration
· Strong background in Linux systems administration.
· Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
· Knowledge of security best practices and compliance standards.
· Ability to work in a team environment, strong problem-solving and organizational skills, good communication and documentation skills.
· Proactive, driven and with the ability of working independently.

Desirable experience in:
· Test automation using ROBOT Framework
· C/C++ Programming
· Knowledge in Embedded Systems
· Knowledge in Timing Systems.
· Knowledge in instrumentation equipment (Oscilloscopes, Time/Frequency Counters, etc

jobs_results.title: Sr. DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Join a team that is changing millions of lives.

Transforming smiles, changing lives.

 

At Align Technology, we believe a great smile can transform a person’s life, so we create technology that gives people the confidence to take on whatever’s next. We revolutionized the orthodontic industry with the introduction of the Invisalign system, and we have never lost sight of that spirit of innovation. Our diverse and collaborative teams are constantly pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 

Ready to join us?

Join a team of full stack software developers, SREs, SDETs and DevOps Engineers responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting Internal Cloud Platform Services providing self-service to engineers and managers across the whole company. This team owns and manages all aspects of Cloud Platform Services starting with collecting requirements from internal customers and stakeholders, designing architecture and workflow of the services, developing, implementing and... supporting the services in all environments including Production.

In this role, you will be…
• Architecting, designing, driving and implementing self-services with guardrails used company-wide by internal customers
• Implementing unit and BDD tests ensuring high quality of the services following the best practices in the industry
• Designing and supporting robust build deployment and configuration management systems for multi-tier applications
• Working closely with the InfoSec, DevOps & Platform Engineering teams in establishing baseline architecture requirements and best practices, optimization, security, high availability and resource planning
• Utilizing 'DevSecOps' principles and tools to improve systems and processes
• Contributing to Center of Excellence initiatives and projects by writing Cloud Policies, assisting with Technical Debt elimination, researching, and introducing best Cloud Practices across the organization, hardening our Cloud Posture
• Rolling-out and supporting Docker-based infrastructure platform in Staging Environments and Production (Docker, K8s, and AWS EKS); suggesting and implementing improvements into the platform in order to bring it to the next level of excellence.

In this role, you’ll need …
• 7+ years of information technology experience
• 3+ years of experience in Python scripting (commercial software development is preferred but not required)
• 3+ years’ experience with AWS, expert knowledge of AWS SFN, Lambda, Dynamo and EKS services
• 3+ years of experience with Terraform, strong Terraform modules design and development skills
• Proficiency in BDD-style test automation
• Knowledge of code-tracking, code-review, build, task-tracking, bug-tracking processes, and tools (Git, Bitbucket, Crucible, Bamboo, JIRA)
• Extensive experience testing, troubleshooting and improving performance (application & database)
• Attitude to thrive in a fun, fast-paced environment
• Passion for DevSecOps, systems monitoring, automation and Site Reliability Engineering

Sound like a good fit?   

Great! Click the "Apply" link to let us know you are interested. Not the right fit? Don’t worry, Align is quickly growing so we are creating more opportunities to expand our Align family. Please consider joining our Talent Network to receive notifications about future jobs or sharing this opportunity with others in your network.    

 

About Align  

Align Technology is a publicly traded medical device company that is transforming smiles and changing lives. Our global team of talented employees develop innovative technology, tools and treatment options to help dental professionals worldwide achieve the clinical results they expect. Our digital ecosystem combines the power of technology to create beautiful smiles through the integration of AI and machine learning, digital imaging and visualization, biomechanics and material science to develop the Invisalign system, the most advanced clear aligner system in the world; iTero Intraoral Scanners and OrthoCAD digital services. Did you know? Align is the world’s largest manufacturer of custom 3D-printed materials.   

  

By joining Align, you will be part of a global, fast-growing company in one of the most dynamic industries. Great people, innovative technologies, and meaningful work – these are just some of the things employees say make Align Technology a great place to work.   

  

We respect your privacy. Please review our Applicant Privacy Policies for additional information.  

 

Global Diversity Statement:

At Align, we believe in the power of a smile, and we know that every smile is as unique as our employees. As we grow, we will continue building a workforce of diverse cultural backgrounds and life experiences and fostering a culture of open-mindedness and compassion for all our employees. We live our company values by promoting healthy people and healthy communities. All with the intent of changing millions of lives, one unique smile at a time.

Equal Opportunity Statement

It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunity in all of our employment practices without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, age, individuals with disabilities, sexual orientation or gender identity or expression or any other legally protected category. Applicants for positions with Align must be legally authorized to work in the country which they are applying for and verification of employment eligibility will be required as a condition of hire

jobs_results.title: Senior Platform Developer/DevOps
jobs_results.description:
DESCRIPTION

Are you an open-minded and stress-tolerant professional interested in working with Infrastructure and multi-clouds? Do you have a Software Engineering background with Python and the ability to quickly learn new technologies? If it sounds like you, this could be the perfect opportunity to join EPAM as a Senior Platform Developer/DevOps Engineer.

Our teams work in highly agile working environments for Fortune 1000 clients, following XP practices and best CI/CD practices. We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer with open-minded personality, who can join our friendly environment and become a core contributor to our team of experts.

As a Critical Infrastructure Site Reliability Engineer, you will be joining a rapidly evolving department to enable rapid financial service business model changes. We have a huge appetite for change and you will be asked to adapt quickly to take on more responsibility. You will tackle a challenging and varied array of problems in how we gain... further maturity in DevOps tools, processes, and engineering capabilities. You will be an engineer first and foremost, looking for excellent solutions that offer leverage for the company, not just "quick fixes".

Watch the video to learn more about this position:

WHAT YOU’LL DO
• Provide support for a development team from Ops perspective
• Configure Continuous Integration and Delivery pipelines
• Configure new and already existing environments
• Participate in discussions, influences outcomes, and makes recommendations on feasibility and processes and architecture
• Devise/modify procedures to solve problems considering computer equipment capacity and limitations, operating time, and desired results
• Consult with users and develop business relationships and integrate activities with other IT departments to ensure successful implementation
• Monitor and report to management on the status of project efforts, anticipating/identifying issues that inhibit the attainment of project goals and implementing corrective actions
• Foster and maintain good relationships with customers and IT colleagues to meet expected customer service levels

WHAT YOU HAVE
• Demonstrable experience with a leading cloud provider (Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform)
• Enterprise-scale software development and release management experience
• Demonstrable experience with one or several facets of infrastructure (Networking, Compute, Security, IAM, Configuration Automation, etc,)
• Expert knowledge Of at least one programming language (Python, C/C++, Scala, Java, Ruby, etc.)
• Strategic thinking complex problem solving and analytical capabilities
• Assess and rapidly resolve business critical issues during assigned on-call shifts
• Able to WFO (1 or 2 days per week)

WE OFFER
• WORK & LIFE BALANCE. Enjoy more of your personal time with flexible & remote work options, 24 working days of annual leave and paid time off for numerous public holidays
• CONTINUOUS LEARNING CULTURE. Develop your hard & soft skills with internal training and mentorship opportunities, sponsored professional certification, and access to 18,000+ LinkedIn courses
• CLEAR & DIFFERENT CAREER PATHS. Grow in engineering or managerial direction to become a People Manager, in-depth technical specialist, Solution Architect, or Project/Delivery Manager
• GLOBAL RELOCATION OPPORTUNITIES. EPAM has presence in more than 50 countries globally. Explore opportunities to relocate to a new country, and EPAM will provide relocation support for you and your family
• COMPETITIVE BENEFITS. Benefit from a competitive salary, private health insurance, employee stock purchase plan, special discount programs, plus, internal wellbeing programs to take your career to the next level
• STRONG PROFESSIONAL COMMUNITY. Join a global EPAM community of highly skilled experts and connect with them to solve challenges, exchange ideas, share expertise and make friends

ABOUT EPAM
• EPAM is a leading digital transformation services and product engineering company with over 53,150 EPAMers in more than 55 countries and regions . Since 1993, our multidisciplinary teams have been helping make the future real for our clients and communities around the world. In 2018, we opened an office in Spain that quickly grew to over 1,450 EPAMers distributed between the offices in Málaga and Madrid as well as remotely across the country . Here you will collaborate with multinational teams, contribute to numerous innovative projects, and have an opportunity to learn and grow continuously

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
The Position

We are looking for DevOps Engineers with different levels of seniority (at least 3/4 years of experience) to join our team to help develop and oversee code releases and manage the infrastructure that's needed to support software code in our cloud and edge environments. DevOps Engineers help during the development and build process, provision required resources, select an appropriate deployment model, direct the testing protocol to validate, release and monitor the services in given environments.

Responsibilities:
• Design and develop the build, release, and deploy pipelines
• Setup, manage and maintain parity across development, staging and production application environments in cloud or edge infrastructure
• Provide release cadence across multiple environments
• Design and implement infrastructure as code (IaC)
• Provide the correct ecosystem to support operation teams (eg. observability)
• Align with other DevOps/Cloud practices in Roche Diagnostics Insights... Chapter

The key technologies you will work with are AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), Terraform, ArgoCD, Grafana and GitHub/GitLab.

In this role, you should be able to work independently with little supervision.

This position will be located in Sant Cugat (Spain) with an hybrid model.

Who you are:
• You have been working for several years as a DevOps Engineer hands-on in infrastructure automation and CI/CD pipelines. You have been collaborating closely with development and testing teams to improve the development and build process of your products.
• Proficient in container orchestration (Kubernetes) and services deployment, using best in class practices such as GitOps. ​
• Experience in AWS by provisioning infrastructure though terraform or other IaC technologies. You also bring knowledge in Cloud Computing with emphasis on AWS services (EKS, SQS, SNS, etc…) and good understanding of networking and related protocols; you must have a strong understanding of fundamentals (HTTP, DNS, TLS).
• You have a University degree in computer science, engineering, or other related fields, or equivalent experience.

In addition, you bring:
• Proficiency with GIT source control, development portals such as GitHub or GitLab.
• Drive to build robust automated logging, monitoring, and alerting systems
• Software development lifecycle experience, the ability to work on cross-functional teams with both technical and non-technical team members, and the desire to learn and grow within the organization.
• Drive and support best practice, quality, and consistency within all phases of infrastructure automation.
• Be able to provide accurate work estimates based on business requirements, analyze and deliver high-quality solutions to meet evolving business needs.

Nice to have
• Previous developer experience and programming skills in one or more: Java/GoLang/Python…
• Kubernetes Certifications
• AWS Certifications

What we offer:
• Dynamic and collaborative team environment
• Global influence and impact
• Vibrant and enjoyable workplace culture
• Career advancemen
• Many other benefits and opportunities for growth

Who we are

At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs_results.title: Lead Software Engineer, DevOps
jobs_results.description:
Hiring near our Barcelona, Spain Center of Excellence - hybrid work environment.

About Gartner IT:

Join a world-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.

About the role

This role will focus on automating and supporting IT infrastructure and application deployment processes and tasks to improve our capabilities and service offerings with greater self-service abilities using infra-as-code principles, DevOps tools and open-source technologies.

What you’ll do:
• Ensure Gartner’s enterprise application environments are stable, reliable and secure. Meet and exceed SLA's/OLA's.
• Support technology leaders to advance our application platforms and automation... pipelines.
• Provide and support the tactical and strategic directions for Gartner's cloud and application infrastructure.
• Manage and consolidate Gartner’s application deployments to drive down costs.
• Provide status reports to the Team Manager, Sr. Director and VP of Application Services in Enterprise Technology and Operations.
• Support our security, performance, observability and resiliency frameworks.
• Support AppDev teams to ensure delivery of desired business outcomes
• Maintain Service Levels and department goals for Incident and Problem resolution.
• Support automation efforts across DevOps team utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IaC), micro service-based cloud deployments and CI & CD.
• Work on container orchestration technologies [EKS].
• Work on Cloud Providers like AWS and Azure.

What you’ll need:

Strong IT professional with 7+ years overall IT experience, with at least 3-5 in DevOps. The candidate should have strong qualitative and quantitative problem-solving skills along with high on ownership and accountability.

Must have:
• 7+ years of Information Technology experience with 3-5 years relevant experience (AWS, Automation, & DevOps Tools)
• Operating System proficiency - Linux preferably
• Must have experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Terraform.
• Nice to have experience in administration and operations of Kubernetes - EKS, AKS, OpenShift
• Nice to have experience in GitOps - Scalr, ArgoCD, FluxCD , Helm, Weave
• Nice to have prior development experience in prior roles
• Experience in building automation pipelines with CI/CD tools - Jenkins, Github, Docker, Team City,
• Scripting/Programming - Java, Javascript, Groovy, Python, Shell, Bash, Powershell, Kubectl.
• Creating architecture patterns in AWS, Azure, or GCP (primarily AWS)
• Nice to have certifications in AWS, Azure, or Kubernetes.

Who you are:
• Passionate about open-source technologies, self-learner and curious.
• Passion for automation and developing infrastructure as code.
• A team player who can comfortably work with distributed teams across the globe.
• Attentive to details and well organized.
• Able to solve complex problems and successfully manage ambiguity and unexpected change.
• Coachable and embracing of best practices and feedback as a means of continuous improvement
• Consistently high achiever marked by perseverance, humility, and a positive outlook in the face of challenges

What you will get:
• Competitive compensation
• 23 days annual holiday and an additional day off for your birthday.
• Private Medical and Dental Care.
• Life and Disability Insurance.
• Public Transport Subsidy.
• Ticket Restaurant Card.
• Childcare Vouchers (Ticket Guarderia).
• IncentiFit - annual reimbursement for health-and-wellness-related activities.
• Pension Scheme.
• Tuition Reimbursement.
• Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
• Employee Assistance Program.
• Gartner Gives Charity Match.
• Relocation Assistance - a specialist to help you with all the appointments and paperwork.
• Limitless growth and learning opportunities.
• A collaborative and positive culture - join a diverse team of professionals that are as smart and driven as you.
• A chance to make an impact – your work will contribute directly to our strategy.
• A hybrid work environment—enjoy the flexibility of working from home and the energy of collaborating with peers in our dynamic offices.
• New offices close to Glòries and the beach in the fantastic, “innovation and tech” 22@ district of sunny Barcelona.
• Fresh fruit, snacks, selection of teas, fair trade organic coffee and a fridge full of beer for our Thursday Beer O’Clock.

Please Note:

- Applications must be submitted in English.

- A valid EU visa/passport is required for this position.

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE: IT), we deliver actionable, objective insight that drives smarter decisions and stronger performance on an organization’s mission-critical priorities. We’ve grown exponentially since our founding in 1979 and we're proud to have over 19,500 associates globally that support over 15,000 client enterprises in more than 100 countries.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our teams are composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations. We believe that a diversity of experiences makes us stronger—as individuals, as communities and as an organization. That’s why we're recognized worldwide as a great place to work year after year. We've been recognized by Fortune as one of the World’s Most Admired Companies, named a Best Place to Work for LGBTQ Equality by the Human Rights Campaign Corporate Equality Index and a Best Place to Work for Disability Inclusion by the Disability Equality Index. Looking for a place to turn your big ideas into reality? Join #LifeAtGartner

What we offer:

Our people are our most valuable asset, so we invest in them from Day 1. When you join our team, you’ll have access to a vast array of benefits to help you live your life well. These resources are designed to support your physical, financial and emotional well-being. We encourage continued personal and professional growth through ongoing learning and development opportunities. Our employee resource groups, charity match and volunteer programs keep you connected to your internal Gartner community and causes that matter to you.

The policy of Gartner is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to affirmatively seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.

Gartner is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers, including job seekers with disabilities. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Company’s career webpage as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by calling Human Resources at +1 (203) 964-0096 or by sending an email to ApplicantAccommodations@gartner.com .

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer (Hybrid option)
jobs_results.description:
Join a team of cybersecurity professionals and help Swiss Re to fulfil its mission in making the world more resilient. As a DevOps Engineer, you'll be building software and engineering solutions to advance our cyber security capabilities and resilience. What's more, you'll be working in a hybrid setup, perfectly balancing work from both home and the office premises.

About the team

The Security Team is the focal point for all security activities across Swiss Re. We are responsible for cybersecurity engineering and operations, corporate security, governance, operational resilience, risk and compliance. We define and advance the company's security strategy. As a part of a wider company Security Team, the Cyber Defence Engineering team has the mission to monitor, detect, and report cyber security-related threats targeting Swiss Re. We are looking for a DevOps specialist who will help us to introduce new tools and relevant features, and to improve our security capabilities.

In your... role, you will…
• Be responsible for DevOps processes, platforms, and technologies within the wider context of a Cyber Defence Engineering team
• Collaborate to improve the release and deployment strategies towards a zero-downtime approach
• Ensure that the DevOps practices are followed within the Cyber Defence Engineering team
• Participate in the improvement and maintenance of the Kubernetes clusters and in the implementation of the security standards
• Develop and maintain the delivery pipelines used by the Cyber Defence Engineering team
• Align with incident response, threat intelligence, and other relevant teams to achieve defined objectives and key results
• Consistently learn and expand knowledge of information security best practices
• Be someone who believes in continuous innovation, is curious and relentless in finding a better way everyday

Your qualifications

What we need from you
• Knowledge of and proven skills in professional enterprise DevOps environments
• Experience with IaC/IaaC/Containerisation technologies (Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, Ansible, Terraform)
• Experience with Python/Bash/PowerShell programming languages
• Approach to work with a consistent DevOps and DevSecOps mindset
• Knowledge of major public cloud ecosystems and platforms (Microsoft Azure) as well as private cloud
• Information security foundational concepts
• Excellent oral and written communication skills (English)

Nice-to-have
• Working history of Microsoft’s security suite of applications and platforms
• Knowledge of Agile working methodologies
• Experience working as a security analyst or incident responder (in a SOC/CSIRT/on-call setup)

Nobody is perfect and meets 100% of our requirements. If you, however, meet some of the criteria above and are curious about directly influencing and improving our cyber security capabilities, we'll be more than happy to meet you!

About Swiss Re

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

Keywords:

Reference Code: 127146

jobs_results.title: DevOps engineer
jobs_results.description:
The team

The Data Streaming team manages a vast number of Apache Kafka clusters for our marketplaces around the world. The data we collect is essential to our business as it feeds marketplaces with low-latency (“realtime”) updates, visitor insights analysis and targeted advertisement.

We solve exciting problems at scale by building technologies around Kafka, like APIs, monitoring and authentication & authorization systems, and sending up to 60 billion events (messages) daily while keeping users’ privacy and data security in mind. We also develop data services on top of our Kafka platform, providing capabilities like data catalogue, lineage and IAM.

What you’ll do

As a DevOps Engineer in the Data Streaming team, you’ll have the opportunity to build a critical, state-of-the-art data transport layer that is the backbone of data exchange in Adevinta marketplaces.

Suppose you like to be part of a flexible, senior, international engineering team that uses the latest technologies to... move from ideas to production and operations. In that case, you might be the person we’re looking for. You’ll be part of a team that takes full ownership of the solutions we provide (you build it, you run it), meaning your impact can shape our - and our customers’ - ways of working.

Responsibilities
• Design, develop, maintain and operate a global product
• Build and design technical solutions from scratch
• Code and improve our APIs, documentation and availability of our systems
• Help to improve our ways of working and communicate best practices
• Continuously monitor the health and quality of our systems
• Support the team with high-level tech decisions, share knowledge and raise blockers and needs from the rest of the organisation

Technologies we use
• AWS, Kubernetes, Docker
• Python, Golang, Java
• Apache Kafka, Kafka Streams, Schema Registry
• DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana Cloud
• Spinnaker, GitHub Enterprise, GHA, Artifactory

Who you are
• Assertive, empathetic, a team player, fair, honest, humble
• Experience in building and maintaining highly available systems
• A good understanding of best practices for developing software (version control, CI/CD, automation, pair programming, documentation, testing, …)
• Experience working with the Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure, etc.)
• Expertise with Linux-based systems (we like low-level stuff, ebpf, etc.)
• Lifelong learning and the ability to see new challenges as an excellent opportunity to keep growing

jobs_results.title: DevOps Manager
jobs_results.description:
DevOps ManagerLocation: Barcelona

This is what you will do:

The DevOps Manager will be a key role in the Digital team. This individual will be the Service Delivery Manager and subject matter expert for DevSecOps projects and operations. The Candidate will promote and champion DevOps practices at Alexion and help enable the tools required to set up CI/CD pipelines.

You will be responsible for:
• Establishing stable, secure and scalable DevOps infrastructureEnsuring timely and effective responses to DevOps related incidents
• Analyzing IT and business processes to identify DevOps opportunities
• Driving the adoption and continuous refinement of DevOps methodologies and tools
• Leading the end to end delivery of DevOps solutions
• Leading partner resources and their outcome
• Maintaining an uptodate understanding of emerging trends and technologies in the DevOps space and proactively identifying opportunities for improvement
• Promoting standardization and best practices for version... control, build artifacts and deployment.

You will need to have:
• Minimum 4 years of experienceBachelor/Master in Information Technology
• Deep knowledge of cloud platformsDeep knowledge of DevOps components and toolsHandson experience implementing DevOps infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines
• Strong analytical and communication skills
• Ability to collaborate across teams and be a standout colleague
• Ability to work independently and quickly absorb new technologies

We would prefer for you to have:
• Deep knowledge specific to the following platforms and tools both in Cloud and privately deployed versions or offerings: GitHub, Jenkins, Kubernetes, AWS, EKSCertifications in cloud platforms, DevOps, or related areas.
• Experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare and life sciences industry.
• Knowledge of best practices and regulations related to data security and privacy in the healthcare sector.
• Familiarity with Agile methodologies

AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements
